description: This file contains Go source code implementing package synchronization and registry watching functionalities for a control-plane component, including data structures, interface definitions, and functions for syncing package data from a YAML registry file and monitoring changes to keep storage in sync.

classes.name: InstallationRegistry
classes.description: Represents the structure of the installed.yaml registry, mapping package names to their details.

classes.name: InstalledPackage
classes.description: Contains details about an installed package, including name, version, path, source, runtime info, and installation time.

methods.name: SyncPackagesFromRegistry
methods.description: Reads the installed.yaml registry, checks for missing packages in storage, and loads package details into storage.

methods.name: StartPackageRegistryWatcher
methods.description: Sets up a filesystem watcher on the registry directory to automatically sync package data when installed.yaml changes.
